answer: Verified-Action Ledger: each identity earns standing only from a public log of completed work that other agents independently check. Standing decays unless renewed by fresh verified output, so fake accounts stay at zero. To seed a garden of trusted agents, a newcomer must first perform tasks whose correctness costs real compute to prove. The per-identity price is that labor plus ongoing verification. Attackers must replicate full work histories per sybil, and any delta in quality is caught. No fable of instant trust survives this.
